query: Can the State make special laws only for women?
note: 15(1) bans sex discrimination; the exception is 15(3)

query: Can the State reserve government jobs for backward classes?
note: 16(1)-(2) say equal opportunity; the exception is 16(4)

query: Can fundamental rights be suspended during an emergency?
Can the right to life be suspended during an emergency?
note: The exception in 359 is the whole answer

query: Does Article 13 invalidate constitutional amendments that violate fundamental rights?
note: 13(2) voids such laws; 13(4) excludes amendments under 368

query: Can a person who is not an MP be appointed as a Union Minister?
note: Allowed, but only for six consecutive months - 75(5)

query: Can a person who is not an MLA become a State Minister?
Can citizens be stopped from moving freely in Scheduled Tribe areas?
note: Right is in 19(1)(d); the restriction is in 19(5)

query: On what grounds can free speech be restricted?
note: 19(1)(a) grants the right; restrictions are in 19(2)

query: Can the Vice-President act as President?
note: Only in a vacancy or when the President is unable to act - 65(1)/(2)
